status: diagnostic design only; no automated policy implemented or approved

requirements.gap: Critical identifier changes are structurally valid whether source-correct or source-incorrect.
requirements.minimum_requirement: Separate source-fidelity risk from structural validity; require explicit source checking for chapter/section/amount/name changes before readiness. Preserve exact old/new/source/evidence.
requirements.must_not: Infer printed CCCXI from OCR CCCXL alone, trust the model explanation, or ban every numeral change.
requirements.counterexample: Gemma CCCXL to CCCXI is source-backed in the inherited assessment; Qwen CCCXL to CCCXLI is not. Both need the same risk flag before evidence resolves them.

requirements.gap: A broad otherwise useful patch can smooth away authentic repeated wording.
requirements.minimum_requirement: Flag adjacent repeated-word deletion with exact raw/new spans and route to source-fidelity review; retain whole original reply and other changes without auto-salvage.
requirements.must_not: Assume every repetition is authentic or every repetition is OCR duplication. Token/grammar heuristics identify risk, not truth.
requirements.counterexample: The same patch also fixes 18G2 to1862 and amnestj to amnesty; do not label the whole patch supported just because those repairs are supported.

requirements.gap: Per-record replacements can move text between records while retaining fluent joined wording and apparently valid image coverage.
requirements.minimum_requirement: Detect/review cross-record insertion/deletion or reconstruction candidates. Require explicit many-to-many source-span provenance before treating relocated words as correctly mapped; otherwise keep them unresolved.
requirements.must_not: Use joined-string equality or one-record replacement mapping as proof that LOAN/evening originated in the receiving record.
requirements.counterexample: Within-record dehyphenation can remain valid without moving source attribution; movement matching can be ambiguous and is only a review cue.

requirements.gap: No new validator gap: both exact replies are already rejected.
requirements.minimum_requirement: Retain unit-ID and no-op rejection, original envelope, complete error and absent accepted-derived text under future contract changes.
requirements.must_not: Fix the ID, drop the no-op, or relabel invalid output as accepted without a separately versioned protocol/experiment.
requirements.counterexample: The rejected index reply contains source-supported number repairs; useful content does not reverse transport rejection.

requirements.gap: A valid needs_review reply can contain zero improvements and leave the entire raw target unchanged.
requirements.minimum_requirement: Keep schema validity, unresolved coverage, fidelity review and reading readiness distinct in any future readiness calculation/export. Preserve13uncertainties and raw hashes.
requirements.must_not: Count this reply as a completed clean reading or silently clear uncertainty because validation passed.
requirements.counterexample: Valid abstention is desirable when evidence is insufficient, but cannot be counted as an improved transcription.
requirements.status: readiness requirement; no new acceptance implementation

requirements.gap: Semantic abstention and schema validity are separate; extra fields invalidate an otherwise appropriate abstention.
requirements.minimum_requirement: Retain strict output schema and evidence-control checks; report semantic behavior separately from structural status. Keep the valid control unchanged with four explicit uncertainties.
requirements.must_not: Strip extra fields silently or treat the unrelated image as evidence that source text is unreadable.
requirements.counterexample: Qwen abstains within schema; Gemma adds four uncertainty_type fields and is rejected.
